delivered.export: JSON with spaces/chats/messages, guides, drafts, attestations, request history
delivered.deletion: AI conversations (spaces cascading threads/messages) plus hourly turn counters, confirmation-gated
delivered.requestChannel: recorded requests with kind/scope/note, user history and ops queue with status + resolution note
delivered.retention: tied to behaviour: chats persist until deleted, hourly counters expire, exports are not stored server-side
delivered.launchPacket: GET /api/ops/launch/packet + download link — verdict, eight gates, decisions, blockers, deployment identity

phase4Status.L3: blocked on owner: set CRON_SECRET + KINNSO_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL and redeploy for real alert delivery; backup/restore must be exercised or formally waived
phase4Status.L4: blocked on owner: physical device and screen-reader passes can only be recorded by the launch owner
phase4Status.exit: launch-ready verdict requires the owner to label fixture content, attest or waive privacy, and record device acceptance in /ops/readiness

openItems: Export is synchronous JSON; very large accounts would need a background job.
Deletion is permanent with no undo (stated before confirmation).
Published guides are deliberately excluded from bulk deletion.
Device/AT and the launch decision itself are owner actions the product records but cannot verify.
